0171: def EFDM_test(input_image, normal_image, lamda = 0.5):
0172: 
0173:     lamda = 1-lamda
0174:     input_x = input_image
0175: 
0176: 
0177:     normal_x = normal_image
0178: 
0179: 
0180:     B, C, W, H = input_x.size(0), input_x.size(1), input_x.size(2), input_x.size(3)
0181: 
0182: 
0183:     input_x_view = input_x.view(B, C, -1)
0184:     normal_x_view = normal_x.view(B, C, -1)
0185: 
0186:     value_input_x, index_input_x = torch.sort(input_x_view)
0187:     value_normal_x, index_normal_x = torch.sort(normal_x_view)
0188:     new_input_x = value_input_x + (value_normal_x - value_input_x) * lamda
0189:     inverse_index = index_input_x.argsort(-1)
0190:     new_input_x = new_input_x.gather(-1, inverse_index)
0191:     new_input_x = new_input_x.view(B, C, W, H)
0192:     new_input_x = new_input_x.cpu().detach().numpy()
0193:     new_input_x = torch.from_numpy(new_input_x)
0194: 
0195:     return new_input_x
